claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.direct_apply
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spare the Dying applies Stable unconditionally on a valid target — no attack roll, no saving throw. No existing ActivationPhase variant (attack_roll, save_gate) can represent an unconditional direct-apply resolution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.apply_condition (for spell ActivationPhase)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell Effect type used by ActivationPhase is DamageEffect | NoneEffect. A condition-apply variant is needed for spells that directly apply conditions with no damage. The apply_condition atom IS in v4 taxonomy — only the surface type is missing it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition.stable
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition union currently only contains 'prone'. 'stable' (SRD 5.2.1 Rules Glossary) is the sole effect of this spell and must be added.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Range with threshold-tier scaling
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cantrip upgrade doubles range at character levels 5/11/17 (15→30→60→120 ft). Range is currently a fixed-shape type with no scaling variant. A threshold_tiers<Range> or analogous scaled-range shape is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Cantrip Upgrade: The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).
